title: Geometry Is Not Robustness: A Trajectory-Level Study of PGD Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2608.14594v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Projected Gradient Descent (PGD) is widely used to evaluate adversarial robustness, typically via final adversarial accuracy, which does not capture model behaviour throughout the attack. Recent work proposes trajectory-level diagnostics, such as loss evolution, gradient alignment, and steps-to-failure, for deeper insight into adversarial optimisation dynamics. However, whether these diagnostics reliably indicate robustness strength remains unclear. We conduct a trajectory-level investigation of PGD attacks on convolutional neural networks trained on Fashion-MNIST. We compare clean-trained and adversarially-trained models across multiple robustness regimes, using rigorous 20-step PGD evaluations with random initialisation and multiple restarts for robustness measurement, and single-initialisation trajectory recording for diagnostics. We record full PGD trajectories across 3000 clean-correct samples per model and analyse loss evolution, g

translated_title: 几何并非鲁棒性：PGD评估的轨迹级研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14594v1 公告类型：新 摘要：投影梯度下降（PGD）被广泛用于评估对抗鲁棒性，通常通过最终对抗准确性来衡量，但这无法捕捉攻击过程中的模型行为。最近的研究提出了轨迹级诊断方法，如损失演化、梯度对齐和失败步数，以深入洞察对抗优化动态。然而，这些诊断是否可靠地指示鲁棒性强弱仍不清楚。我们对在Fashion-MNIST上训练的卷积神经网络进行了PGD攻击的轨迹级研究。我们比较了干净训练和对抗训练模型在多种鲁棒性机制下的表现，使用严格的20步PGD评估，采用随机初始化和多次重启来测量鲁棒性，并使用单初始化轨迹记录进行诊断。我们记录了每个模型3000个干净正确样本的完整PGD轨迹，并分析了损失演化和g。
tldr: 该论文通过轨迹级分析发现，PGD评估中的几何特征（如损失演化）并不能可靠指示模型的对抗鲁棒性，挑战了传统诊断方法的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals through trajectory-level analysis that geometric features in PGD evaluation, such as loss evolution, do not reliably indicate model adversarial robustness, challenging the effectiveness of traditional diagnostic methods.
